provenance: Selected unchanged case records from completed same-run Analysis; no new Production experiment.
method: Source-derived isolated function probe: whitespace-normalized upstream function bodies reindented; SecurityRisk.UNKNOWN sentinel and known-risk comparator test double.
controls: Toggle confirm_unknown; comparator true/false; unknown/known threshold.
finding: UNKNOWN follows confirm_unknown; known risk delegates to is_riskier with the unchanged threshold; UNKNOWN threshold raises.
limits: Not an installed SDK execution, Pydantic integration test, risk-enum comparator test or authorization enforcement audit.
Threshold equality is upstream code commentary, not measured with the real enum here.
No direct-tool bypass, replay, expiry, filesystem attack or full four-framework replication performed; study archive not available in admitted inputs.
Current documentation and pinned code are different evidence nodes.
